tables.name: account
tables.description: One stored person, exactly one role. Password hashes only; authentication and session identity remain application responsibilities.

tables.name: account_restriction
tables.description: Moderator warning, temporary restriction or ban referral. Does not change account.status or authorize a ban.

tables.name: analytics_report
tables.description: Saved report criteria and result summary; dates must be ordered.

tables.name: category
tables.description: Media, genre and tag vocabulary; unique category name within kind.

tables.name: comment
tables.description: Work discussion with optional GIF and added moderation visibility.

tables.name: comment_report
tables.description: Added reporting for comments; every insert opens exactly one moderation case.

tables.name: conversation
tables.description: Added general private conversations shared by all roles.

tables.name: conversation_member
tables.description: Added membership and read tracking. The application restricts conversation reads to authenticated members.

tables.name: creative_work
tables.description: One row per portfolio work; feature/archive/edit/moderation update this row. Removal uses visibility=removed.

tables.name: feedback_reply
tables.description: At most one reply per feedback; added creator_id and trigger ensure the recorded author owns the reviewed work.

tables.name: follow
tables.description: Unique account-to-creator relationship; self-follow is rejected.

tables.name: help_ticket
tables.description: Account support request; added assignment, response and resolution date support shared help queues.

tables.name: invitation
tables.description: Unique opportunity/creator pair with response status and added response timestamp.

tables.name: mentor_feedback
tables.description: One structured feedback per accepted request; composite FK keeps work and mentor consistent with that request.

tables.name: moderation_case
tables.description: One work OR comment report, never both. Nullable moderator permits an unassigned open queue entry; decisions require moderator assignment.

tables.name: nomination
tables.description: Mentor nominates; moderator approves/declines. Approved rows drive the featured community feed.

tables.name: notification
tables.description: Added per-account notification/read tracking. Application writes workflow notifications in its transaction.

tables.name: opportunity
tables.description: Talent scout opportunity; invitations are the sole opportunity-to-creator relationship.

tables.name: platform_setting
tables.description: Unique setting name; optional administrator audit metadata. Application validates setting-specific values and honors switches.

tables.name: private_message
tables.description: Added general conversation messages; composite FK requires the stored sender to be a conversation member.

tables.name: review_request
tables.description: Composite ownership FK ensures the requester owns the work. Mentor must be an Account with mentor role.

tables.name: role_application
tables.description: Mentor/scout enrollment approval. Accepted application and matching account are committed atomically; deferred triggers preserve approval.

tables.name: saved_work
tables.description: Unique account-to-work bookmark relationship.

tables.name: scout_candidate
tables.description: Added private scout shortlist; exactly one row per scout/creator pair.

tables.name: scout_message
tables.description: Original scout-to-creator message entity retained; optional shared conversation supports creator replies without changing its meaning.

tables.name: status_change
tables.description: Append-only administrator status audit. Inserting a row locks and updates the target Account; direct status changes fail.

tables.name: user_report
tables.description: A report against one Account; may have several moderator restrictions over time.

tables.name: work_category
tables.description: Added many-to-many work/category junction, one association per pair.

tables.name: work_media
tables.description: Added ordered external media attachments; URLs are references, not uploaded file storage.

tables.name: work_report
tables.description: Every insert atomically opens exactly one moderation case; reason_type supports copyright/fraud escalation.

columns.name: email
columns.description: Canonical lowercase trimmed email, unique across every role.

columns.name: password_hash
columns.description: Encoded salted password hash produced by the application; never a plaintext password. Database checks nonempty storage, not cryptographic correctness.

columns.name: bio
columns.description: Added for creator profiles and scout discovery.

columns.name: expires_at
columns.description: Required future expiry for restrict, NULL for warnings/referrals. Application checks restrictions during actions.

columns.name: featured
columns.description: Creator-selected portfolio feature. Community feature approval is stored separately in nomination.

columns.name: content_text
columns.description: Added to store writing itself rather than only a description; binary media are external URLs in work_media.

columns.name: visibility
columns.description: Added moderation state applied by closing a moderation case: available, hidden or removed.

columns.name: report_id
columns.description: Work-report relationship retained; NULL only for a comment-report case.

columns.name: moderator_id
columns.description: Sprint II required moderator relaxed only for newly auto-opened unassigned cases; required after the open state.

columns.name: escalation_reason
columns.description: Added explanation for copyright, fraud or other escalation; required while escalated.

columns.name: approved_account_id
columns.description: Added accepted-application link; role and canonical email must match the approved account.

columns.name: old_status
columns.description: Captured by trigger from locked account; supplied input is ignored.

constraints.name: application_decision_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'pending'::text) AND (administrator_id IS NULL) AND (decided_at IS NULL) AND (approved_account_id IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'rejected'::text) AND (administrator_id IS NOT NULL) AND (decided_at IS NOT NULL) AND (approved_account_id IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'accepted'::text) AND (administrator_id IS NOT NULL) AND (decided_at IS NOT NULL) AND (approved_account_id IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: application_admin_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (administrator_id, administrator_role) REFERENCES xpression.account(account_id, role)

constraints.name: application_approved_role_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (approved_account_id, requested_role) REFERENCES xpression.account(account_id, role)

constraints.name: music_soundcloud_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((media_type <> 'music'::text) OR ((soundcloud_url IS NOT NULL) AND (soundcloud_url ~ '^https://(www\.)?soundcloud\.com/[^[:space:]]+$'::text))))

constraints.name: work_creator_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (creator_id, creator_role) REFERENCES xpression.account(account_id, role)

constraints.name: request_work_owner_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (work_id, creator_id) REFERENCES xpression.creative_work(work_id, creator_id)

constraints.name: request_mentor_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (mentor_id, mentor_role) REFERENCES xpression.account(account_id, role)

constraints.name: feedback_request_identity_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (request_id, work_id, mentor_id, request_status) REFERENCES xpression.review_request(request_id, work_id, mentor_id, status)

constraints.name: nomination_decision_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'pending'::text) AND (moderator_id IS NULL) AND (decided_at IS NULL)) OR ((status <> 'pending'::text) AND (moderator_id IS NOT NULL) AND (decided_at IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: nomination_mentor_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (mentor_id, mentor_role) REFERENCES xpression.account(account_id, role)

constraints.name: nomination_moderator_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (moderator_id, moderator_role) REFERENCES xpression.account(account_id, role)

constraints.name: opportunity_scout_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (scout_id, scout_role) REFERENCES xpression.account(account_id, role)

constraints.name: invitation_response_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'sent'::text) AND (responded_at IS NULL)) OR ((status <> 'sent'::text) AND (responded_at IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: invitation_creator_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (creator_id, creator_role) REFERENCES xpression.account(account_id, role)

constraints.name: candidate_creator_fk

constraints.name: analytics_admin_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (administrator_id, administrator_role) REFERENCES xpression.account(account_id, role)

constraints.name: moderation_moderator_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (moderator_id, moderator_role) REFERENCES xpression.account(account_id, role)

constraints.name: restriction_expiry_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((action_type = 'restrict'::text) AND (expires_at IS NOT NULL) AND (expires_at > recorded_at)) OR ((action_type <> 'restrict'::text) AND (expires_at IS NULL))))

constraints.name: setting_admin_fk
